notes.note: Photo-judging pass, session with working egress, throttled to one image request every three seconds and no rate limiting hit. 37 images viewed as pixels across the rollout cities (Barcelona, Rome, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Berlin, Lisbon, Genoa): 31 Commons, 5 iNaturalist, 1 Openverse. One approved (bcn_013, the catalogued Maclura of the Ciutadella). The Commons geosearch lane is now almost pure noise for these cities: street corners, facades, a Vespa, a stage screen, a sarcophagus and a street cleaning truck. Rome rom_011 is the near miss, the correct tree per Wikidata coordinates but photographed from above with the crown merged into surrounding canopy. Whole-city verdicts: Barcelona, Rome, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Berlin, Lisbon and Genoa now have no unjudged candidates left, so their remaining photo gaps need a new source, not another sweep.

Photo-judging pass. Only inaturalist-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com was reachable this run: upload.wikimedia.org and api.openverse.org are both refused by the egress proxy (403 on CONNECT), so 310 Commons candidates and all 18 wikidata ones, plus the 3 openverse ones, could not be rendered and were left unjudged rather than approved blind.

Photo-judging pass with working egress. upload.wikimedia.org was reachable (the 2026-08-07 note was a GitHub Actions proxy block, not a dead host); it rate-limits at roughly 1 request per 3 seconds. 29 images rendered and viewed, 5 approved (ber_013, bat_002, bel_001, bel_003, bel_004). Correction to the standing brief: the 19 wikidata candidates were already judged on 2026-08-07 (12 approved, 6 rejected); only ber_013 was outstanding. Barcelona and Rome are exhausted, every remaining unjudged tree in both has zero candidates.

Photo-judging pass, scheduled routine, remote session (not GitHub Actions). upload.wikimedia.org and api.openverse.org both refused (403 on CONNECT via the environment's egress proxy), same policy block as the CI runner. inaturalist-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com was reachable, so this pass judged the 20 reachable iNaturalist candidates across 8 trees with no prior outcome (Barcelona x9 across 3 trees, Edinburgh, Geneva x2, Groningen, Krakow, Malaga): all 20 rejected, leaf/fruit/bark/hand close-ups or backlit canopy shots with no readable trunk. bcn_002, bcn_013, edi_007 and kra_003 each still carry one unreached Wikimedia or Openverse candidate and stay open rather than closed out. Four other candidates in the queue (lis_013, mad_002, mil_011, prg_012) were already judged on 2026-08-07 by an earlier pass (held/rejected); this pass checked candidate-level `judged` fields before viewing anything and left those calls untouched rather than re-judging blind.

Photo-judging pass, scheduled routine. Checked both candidate-level `judged` and tree-level `judged`/`outcome` fields (the earlier same-day pass only checked the former, which would have re-judged ber_013 and lei_005 blind since both are already resolved at the tree level: ber_013 approved via a Wikidata/Wikimedia candidate, lei_005 rejected outright). After that correction, zero candidates in the queue are both unjudged and reachable: the only reachable host is inaturalist-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com, and every iNaturalist candidate in the queue already carries a judged verdict, at either the candidate or tree level. upload.wikimedia.org and api.openverse.org (380 and 4 unjudged candidates respectively) remain fully unreachable this session; confirmed via the agent proxy status endpoint as policy denials (403 on CONNECT), not a rate limit or transient failure. No photos judged this pass; none were available to judge.

Photo-judging pass on the rollout cities (Dublin, New York, Paris). 30 images downloaded and viewed as pixels, throttled to one request every 3.2 seconds with no rate limiting. One approved: nyc_011, the Great Elm of Central Park West, from a CC0 iNaturalist observation whose reverse-geocoded place is literally Central Park West/W 77 St and whose photograph shows the wide low-spreading crown the entry describes. dub_005 (the Provost's Plane) is now exhausted: all ten Commons geosearch candidates are Grafton and Suffolk Street scenes, three of them the Molly Malone statue. par_017 (the Anne Frank Chestnut, Jardin Anne Frank, Paris) is closed out without pixels and deliberately so: every one of the nine candidates is a documented OTHER Anne Frank tree (Yad Vashem, Bedford, Uedelhoven, Utrecht, Bournemouth, a US exhibit, the fallen Amsterdam original) or a museum object, so the rejection rests on the file's own coordinates and description, which is stronger evidence than a pixel could give. New York's iNaturalist lane is mostly phenology close-ups: buds, bark, leaves in the hand. nyc_009's remaining candidates are Quercus alba observations against a Quercus rubra entry, and nyc_012/nyc_013 share the same five candidates, all rejected.
